data.title: 法琳 · 旅店壁炉前的慵懒舒展
data.description: 冒险者旅店温暖的私密客房内，壁炉里的柴火噼啪作响，橙红火光映照着柔软的羊毛厚地毯。法琳换上贴身轻柔的浅米色睡袍，抱着膝盖坐在地毯上。火光烘烤得她白皙脸颊微微发烫泛红，平日温厚的魔法师微微舒展双臂，眼神中流露着毫无防备的依赖与心动。
data.location: cozy rustic tavern room in front of brick fireplace
data.action: sitting on soft woolen rug before warm fireplace, loose off-shoulder nightgown, blushing cheeks from hearth fire, tender vulnerable gaze looking at viewer
data.lighting: warm flickering amber and orange firelight illuminating cozy room
data.mood: cozy rustic warmth, deeply endearing vulnerability
data.promptProse: Lounging on a fluffy wool rug before a crackling tavern fireplace, Faln wears a loose cream nightgown slipping over one bare shoulder. Her flushed cheeks glow in the firelight as she looks up with tender affection.
data.animaCaption: Faln relaxing before a warm fireplace on a soft rug in an off-shoulder nightgown.
